issues.issue: Dependency injection failure in real service tests
issues.description: 6 critical test failures due to dependency injection: 5 failures in context-builder.service.adversarial.spec.ts and 1 in context-builder.service.token-budget.spec.ts. Error: 'TypeError: undefined is not an object (evaluating 'this.prisma.client')' at line 167 of context-builder.service.ts in verifyProjectExists method.
testsCaffected: context-builder.service.adversarial.spec.ts: AC-7 adversarial > reports tokensUsed that is at least as large as the canonicalState token cost alone
context-builder.service.adversarial.spec.ts: AC-7 adversarial > reports tokensUsed equal to the sum of canonicalState + retrievedContext tokens
context-builder.service.adversarial.spec.ts: AC-9 adversarial > throws an error with code === 'PROJECT_NOT_FOUND' (string) when projectId does not exist
context-builder.service.adversarial.spec.ts: AC-9 adversarial > throws an error whose code is a string, not a numeric HTTP status
context-builder.service.adversarial.spec.ts: AC-9 adversarial > throws an error that is an instance of ProjectNotFoundError
context-builder.service.token-budget.spec.ts: AC-7 token budget truncation priority > removes codeIntel (lowest priority) before graphPaths
issues.rootCause: When TestingModule instantiates ContextBuilderService with mocked dependencies, the PrismaService injection fails. The 'this.prisma' field remains undefined despite being provided in the test module's providers array. This prevents the real service implementation from being executed and tested.

issues.issue: AC-9 bug not fixed: ProjectNotFoundError.code returns wrong type
issues.description: Tests attempt to verify that ProjectNotFoundError.code equals the string 'PROJECT_NOT_FOUND'. Current thrown error.code is undefined (not a string). The implementation at lines 16-28 attempts to override the code property using Object.defineProperty, but this override is not working as intended.
issues.notes: This issue cannot be fully verified because of the prior DI failure blocking test execution.

reasoning: Story-scoped test suite has 6 failing tests (17% failure rate) out of 36 total. The primary blocker is a dependency injection issue in the TestingModule setup that prevents the real ContextBuilderService from being instantiated with mocked dependencies. This cascades into 5 adversarial tests and 1 token-budget test failing before their core assertions can execute. The adversarial test comments indicate these are tests for bugs that should be fixed, but the DI issue prevents verification of whether those bugs are fixed. Test files show no signs of compromise (no test modifications detected, no assertion weakening). The implementation can be unit-tested (context-builder.service.spec.ts passes with 13/13 tests when service is fully mocked) and token-estimator utilities work correctly (8/8 tests pass), but the real service code cannot be tested due to DI configuration issues. Verdict: NOT APPROVED - critical test failures prevent verification of story acceptance criteria.
